spec.name: College Football Data API
spec.description: Build college football applications, models, and analysis with game, team, player, recruiting, ranking, and advanced metrics data. Request an API key at CollegeFootballData.com.

apiKey.description: CollegeFootballData API key supplied as a bearer token.

tags.name: games
tags.description: Game schedules, results, box scores, media, and weather.

tags.name: playoffs
tags.description: College Football Playoff brackets, participants, and matchups.

tags.name: teams
tags.description: Teams, rosters, matchups, talent ratings, and ATS records.

tags.name: coaches
tags.description: Head coach identities, careers, seasons, and tenures.

tags.name: players
tags.description: Player search, usage, production, and transfer data.

tags.name: rankings
tags.description: Historical poll rankings and College Football Playoff snapshots.

tags.name: recruiting
tags.description: Player and team recruiting rankings and aggregated ratings.

tags.name: ratings
tags.description: SP+, SRS, Elo, and FPI team ratings.

tags.name: metrics
tags.description: Predicted points, PPA (EPA), win probability, and expected points metrics.

tags.name: stats
tags.description: Player and team statistics, including advanced metrics.

tags.name: draft
tags.description: NFL Draft picks, teams, and position categories.

tags.name: adjustedMetrics
tags.description: Team and player metrics adjusted for opponent strength.

tags.name: info
